items.title: Buddy DeFranco interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: I got that from my sister Maryanne.

ctx.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and it’s a great pleasure to have with us master clarinetist Buddy DeFranco, who just described his instrument as an “agony pipe.”
I got that from my sister Maryanne. Maryanne always called it an agony pipe. She says that’s what it sounded like when I was practicing. And she was right. It’s the strangest instrument.
Difficult. One of the more difficult instruments I think.
